name: Thermal Receipt Printer for WooCommerce
author: Majed Bannani

sections.description:
Thermal Receipt Printer for WooCommerce adds fast, browser-based receipt printing to the WooCommerce orders screen.

Print one order from its row action, or select multiple orders and create a single print document with a separate receipt for each order. No PDF library, cloud account, or external service is required.

Features

  • Print individual receipts from WooCommerce Orders.
  • Print multiple selected orders in one browser print job.
  • Choose 80mm or 58mm thermal paper.
  • Select a receipt logo from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Arabic and English receipt output.
  • Automatic RTL layout and Arabic month names for Arabic receipts.
  • RTL, LTR, or automatic direction controls.
  • Show or hide the date, customer name, phone, payment method, address, customer note, SKU, unit price, and order totals.
  • Add custom footer text.
  • Optionally open the print dialog automatically and close the print tab afterward.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Uses WooCommerce order CRUD APIs.
  • Translation-ready admin interface.

The plugin prints through the browser, so it works with thermal printers configured on the computer or device running the browser. Print margins, scaling, headers, and footers may also be controlled by the browser’s print dialog and printer driver.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect analytics, track users, or send store and order data to external services.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  3. Activate Thermal Receipt Printer for WooCommerce.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Receipt Printer.
  5. Choose the receipt language, paper width, logo, displayed fields, and print behavior.
  6. Print an individual receipt from an order row, or select orders and choose Print receipts from Bulk actions.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create PDF invoices?

No. It creates lightweight browser print pages designed for direct printing to thermal printers.

Which paper widths are supported?

The plugin includes layouts for 58mm and 80mm paper.

Can I print several orders at once?

Yes. Select up to 100 orders and choose Print receipts. Each receipt is separated by a page break.

Does it support Arabic receipts?

Yes. Arabic receipts use right-to-left layout, Arabic labels, and Arabic month names even when the WordPress dashboard language is English.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. HPOS compatibility is declared and orders are accessed through WooCommerce CRUD APIs.

Does it send order information to an external service?

No. Receipt generation happens on your WordPress site and printing happens in the browser. The plugin does not track users or transmit order data to a third party.
